I made my own redesign concept and suggestions as well, https://feedback.vrchat.com/open-beta/p/1878-the-new-social-menu-ui-feedback-and-suggestions

Though I didn't end up designing a concept based on other player profiles, mine was an edit of your own local profile. One thing yours is missing though is an area for the note.

Here's the image of the redesign as well. My post goes over why I made each change, but like yours most of it boils down to wanting it all in 1 screen.

Gonna mention the "Read more" on the new UI from the beta, when clicking on someone full profile, why is it not displaying the full bio if the "full" profile is displayed, if it's only the preview one from the one handed menu sure, but after clicking on someone's preview I'd expect to have everything shown by default and not need to click that.

(On top of the fact that the "Read more" button is prtty small and I've already missclicked like 10 times trying to display someone's full bio in the preview)

Almost half the furries in my friends list or various groups right now.

(not a criticism just funny :>)
Great concept. I feel like the new user profile is an improvement, but it feels way too large and does not display as much information as I would like. Your concept hits the marks that I want

Sorry to be hateful, but the ui before this was way better than what VRChat is trying to roll out. Part of the reason I went out of the Unity 6 Beta.

Edit: I'm gonna hate it a lot more if they continue to roll out the ui onto the main client.
The ui was updated in open beta but it still doesn't solve the core issues that this canny fixes. Mainly, everything is still way too big and too spaced out.

I've been making updated design concepts and individual posts requesting each of them to be reviewed. I made a deliberate point of leaving some of the more specific choices in place so it's not a complete overhaul, and also to leave the bio at full width so it can maintain itself as the more curated and majority section of the profile.

Here are all of the individual posts, each with their own (I think) reasonable reasons to be implemented. If anyone else sees and wants to vote on them.

https://feedback.vrchat.com/open-beta/p/1879-groups-bubble-in-profile-should-show-only-your-represented-group-like-live

https://feedback.vrchat.com/open-beta/p/1879-reimplement-read-more-kind-of

https://feedback.vrchat.com/open-beta/p/1879-local-profile-missing-return-button

https://feedback.vrchat.com/open-beta/p/1879remove-the-profile-wallet-inventory-from-local-profile

Thanks for the mockups! They were genuinely useful, and some of the proposed changes have already landed in different forms. 

We tightened the profile spacing and made the bio scrollable with more lines visible, which covers a good chunk of the "less info at a glance" complaint. 

We're still working on sizing to cut down the leftover empty space, which is a common issue cited both here and in other items. 

For context, one major constraint we're operating with is cross-platform support: the profile must hold up across desktop, VR, and mobile. A layout that's great on one of those can fall apart on another.

@{5acad9ecc9dba010c9c3ec68|full_name} is there any chance we'll get back the location indicator in the quick menu? looking up someone's instance (to check how many people/friends are in there for example, or to check whose instance it is) now requires the extra step of opening the full menu every time and it's really annoying.

@{5acad9ecc9dba010c9c3ec68|full_name} Is there any way the UI could be slightly different on Mobile vs Desktop vs VR? For example, I think the "read more" button is alright on Desktop and wonderful on Mobile, but not so great for VR, where a scrollable field + scrollbar would be much better (VR lasers are good at swiping, not so good at hitting small hitboxes, especially text)
@{61639c94f9e19e2b580bb791|full_name}: That's a totally different issue, please open a new Feedback item for that!

@{64320355debe2a09d344abff|full_name}: I've asked about this, but there's several reasons it isn't feasible. The tl;dr translation: building UIs for each platform independently is the ideal solution, but we don't have the bandwidth on the relevant teams to do that.

Maybe in the future!

I like yours more OP, but this is still trash compared to our previous perfect profile UI.

VRChat was already monetizing the important things, this is just backwards. It looks bad and has tons of accessibility issues.

details:
The new profiles contain less information available at first glance, things are all over the place (e.g. pronouns next to Verified 18+ next to represented group), elements appear big. I believe in having more things at glance, no layout shift (things moving other things), better grouped information, less empty space - better effectiveness and readability in short. 

I put together my slightly reimagined version of the design in the attachment that might better convey what could be improved.

2 screenshots - before and after
